text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, Miracle, thanks a bunch! Going 
shopping with me was a huge help!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could help. I hope the rest of 
the Disciplinary Committee enjoys the 
refreshments—
...Waaah, waaaahhh...! Mamaaa...!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see, you got separated from your mom. 
Don't worry, we'll help you look for her.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: *hic*... *sob*... Waaaahhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mm, it'd be pretty rough on her to walk 
all over while crying this hard. We 
already got a description of her mom, so—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go make a dash and find her! 
Miracle, could you stay here with the 
little girl?! ...See ya!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey there, could you tell me your name?

text_block_list.name: Mii-chan
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Mii-chan...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mii-chan, huh? That's a lovely name. May I 
call you Mii-chan too?

text_block_list.name: Mii-chan
text_block_list.text: Mm... okay. ...*sniff*...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Her tears still won't stop... Her eyes 
are completely red.)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Isn't there something I can do? Anything 
else—... Ah.)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Mii-chan. Would you come with me 
for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing through an arcade 
shopping street, I heard the cheerful 
melody of a piano. ...It was the theme 
song of a famous children's anime.
choice_data_list:
I think it was "The March of Veggie 
Carolyn", wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, someone was playing on the 
street piano. Drawn by the music, I went 
over to take a look...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Sway your head, rustle your leaves, let's 
walk, walk full of healthy pep"♪

text_block_list.name: Mii-chan
text_block_list.text:
"Forward, forward, under the sun, 
everyone's hero, Veggie Carolyn"!

text_block_list.name: Mii-chan
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~!! Big Sister, you're amazing! 
You're so good at the piano~!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...If you had fun, Mii-chan, then 
I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Miracleee, little ladyyy!! I found your 
mamaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mii-chan's Mom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much...! Come on, 
Mii-chan, say thank you too.

text_block_list.name: Mii-chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, big sisters!! Singing was so 
much fun! See you later!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. See you later, Mii-chan.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, oh man...! That performance just now! 
It got me all pumped up, too! Your piano 
playing really is something else, Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it though, surprisingly 
few folks in the academy know you can 
play, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That feels like such a waste! Why not hold 
a mini-concert or something sometime?!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, well... hmm. If it would make 
everyone happy, I'd like to, but... 
Wouldn't it be embarrassing...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I ever had proper lessons. 
It's just—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I lived in the hospital 
for a long time, and I often played with 
the other kids there... But everyone 
always seemed so lonely.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if... there was anything I 
could do to cheer them up, and while 
thinking about that, I found a piano in 
the playroom.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And so you ended up learning how to play 
children's songs and stuff?! No way, 
that's plenty amazing on its own! You 
should be proud of that!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you. But... it's fine.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because Mii-chan smiled. ...That's enough 
for me.
